prior_state_evidence.coordinate_scope: historydrytheta is already rounded dry T+300; source-hour PR206 neighbors contain moisttheta perturbation and staggered geometricW. No WW is invented from W

decision.completed_boundary: actual final-RK native7–8 mass-coordinate vertical face transport connected to consumed states, gradients, instantaneous theta flux and time-averaged PD vapor flux; hourly reversal retained
decision.action: retain current production physics; restrict afternoon forecast applicability. No optical or PBL coefficient correction is justified by this same-case coordinate/face diagnosis
decision.next_single_boundary: If pursuing physical cause, connect actual horizontal face transport and mass normalization to the warm/dry layer7–8 neighborhood and observed/driving thermodynamics and winds before interpreting air origin; the existing observations do not validate native eta mass flux or geometric vertical velocity

definitions.native_mass_flux: rom is the actually consumed map-coupled eta vertical mass flux in native pressure units per second; eta decreases with increasing k. Positive flux points toward increasing eta. It is neither geometric W nor pressure omega
definitions.distinct_stages: theta slow transport uses final-RK predictor instantaneous wwE; PD qv uses acoustic-time-averaged ww_m after WW_SPLIT. Predictor field and source-updated field_old are separately retained
definitions.reference_split: Ftop-Fbottom = [(Ftop-qcenter*Mtop)-(Fbottom-qcenter*Mbottom)] + qcenter*(Mtop-Mbottom). Central actual transported field is the declared reference. Split depends on reference and includes mass convergence; neither part is a unique material heating or moisture source. Native rounding reported separately
definitions.paired_theta: slow theta is transported moist perturbation, not full dry theta. PR206 dry conversion and acoustic vertical terms are separately retained; face split alone does not equal paired dry-theta total
definitions.coordinate_velocity: No W-to-WW conversion or -W*dtheta/dz replacement; native eta and geopotential heights stored. Hourly history drytheta and geometric W are state context, not substep truth
definitions.independent_constraints: PR204 IGRA/METAR and PR205 forcing constrain sampled thermodynamics/cloud presence with time, balloon drift and point/grid limitations, not vertical-motion truth. Analysis and forecast profiles are not identical time intervals
